title: 成画动画：凌厉弹簧 + 可打断 1.5s + SAVE 冻结

searched.q: fixed timestep accumulator javascript game loop / fix your timestep gaffer
searched.takeaway: dt=1/60, accumulator, clamp frameTime≤0.25s, cap 2 steps/frame. Freeze must not accumulate; wake resets lastTime so the pause is skipped, not caught up.

searched.q: spring damping vx *= 0.90 / particle repulsion inverse square / speed clamp
searched.takeaway: v += (target-p)*k; v *= damp. Inverse-square mouse force needs softening + clamp so d→0 does not explode. vmax after forces.
1.5s assemble is noticeable but acceptable (between 1s flow and 10s attention). Time the phase on the simulation clock so freeze does not count; interrupt from current positions, no queue.

searched.q: prefers-reduced-motion matchMedia / SAVE freeze / SETTINGS aria-live
searched.takeaway: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') → snap to formed, no assemble tween. SAVE is a sticky aria-pressed freeze. SETTINGS flashes an aria-live MODE line for 1s.
